searchText: <@!690224518383534174> regarding the portal net testing framework, is there a script that can automatically boot up 2 trin nodes and connect them to each other, instead of manually grabbing the enr from the logs? i was thinking about creating one, if we deem that necessary <@!364458974906548225> so just a quick question. Would you want me to expose a byte stream or handle the data internally and return the chucked payload concatenated on connection close. If I was to expose a byte stream for some things we might want to start it off with a byte for length of the total payload and a checksum. I mean handling it all internally would probably be best because the other code has no concept of connections really. Also currently from most specs I read it seems like one "connection" per payload. Anyways I implemented a short implementation of LEDBAT and I finished extension support. Currently I just need to think of a way to handle timeouts if we are going to and how it will interact with the rest of the client. Then I will start to test it. I'm not sure how well this fits into the rust context but I'm pretty sure something that looks like a socket where you can read bytes from the stream as they arrive is the desired interface I forget, are utp streams unidirectional or bidirectional? I think we want to avoid having the utp code know anything about payloads and for it to only focus on exposing readable, writable, and closeable streams of bytes I would think bidirectional, but don't quote me. Ok I will work/think/look into that and I will assume you guys will look into handling those bytes then.
